s0401.literal: On jiyou day paper money was granted to the newly submitted troops of Annam who had gone on campaign.
s0401.idiomatic: On jiyou day paper money was granted to Annam's newly submitted troops who had gone on campaign.

s0402.literal: Minister of Rites Liu Mengyan and Andula, envoy to Ma-ba country, and others were granted paper money in varying amounts.
s0402.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Liu Mengyan, Andula, envoy to Ma-ba country, and others received paper money in varying amounts.

s0403.literal: Twelfth month, on jiawu day, Wengjiladai was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.
s0403.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on jiawu day, Wengjiladai was made right grand councillor of the Central Secretariat.

s0404.literal: On jihai day the Japan Branch Secretariat was abolished.
s0404.idiomatic: On jihai day the Japan branch secretariat was abolished.

s0405.literal: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.
s0405.idiomatic: On bingwu day the moon encroached upon the great star of Xuanyuan.

s0406.literal: On dingwei day it was deliberated to select ten thousand Imperial Guard troops for drill, to stand ready for escort duty.
s0406.idiomatic: On dingwei day it was deliberated to select ten thousand Imperial Guard troops for drill to stand ready for escort duty.

s0407.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to regular rank three.
s0407.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices was raised to regular rank three.

s0408.literal: On xinhai day the West Sichuan Branch Secretariat was ordered to supply arms and armor to Wanjianu's command.
s0408.idiomatic: On xinhai day the West Sichuan branch secretariat was ordered to supply arms and armor to Wanjianu's command.

s0409.literal: On guichou day an edict exempted canal laborers of Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai from this year's rent and levies, and still paid them hire wages.
s0409.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict exempted canal laborers of Yidu, Zilai, and Ninghai from this year's rent and levies and still paid them hire wages.

s0410.literal: On yimao day land in Wen'an County occupied by Prince Jaqur was handed over for garrison farming.
s0410.idiomatic: On yimao day land in Wen'an County occupied by Prince Jaqur was handed over for garrison farming.

s0411.literal: On bingchen day newly submitted troops were transferred to garrison farming.
s0411.idiomatic: On bingchen day newly submitted troops were transferred to garrison farming.

s0412.literal: The Fuzhou rebel Lin Tiancheng was captured and executed in the marketplace.
s0412.idiomatic: The Fuzhou rebel Lin Tiancheng was captured and executed in the marketplace.

s0413.literal: Fuzhou Route was exempted from two-tenths of this year's tax, and rents and levies before the eighteenth year were wholly remitted.
s0413.idiomatic: Fuzhou Route was exempted from two-tenths of this year's tax, and all rents and levies before the eighteenth year were remitted.

s0414.literal: Deyang County of Han Prefecture was placed under Chengdu Prefecture.
s0414.idiomatic: Deyang County of Han Prefecture was placed under Chengdu Prefecture.

s0415.literal: Zhang Prefecture was changed to a route.
s0415.idiomatic: Zhang Prefecture was made a route.

s0416.literal: Minister of Rites Xie Changyuan was granted paper money.
s0416.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Xie Changyuan received paper money.

s0417.literal: Niegube was rewarded for battle merit with silver in graded amounts.
s0417.idiomatic: Niegube was rewarded for battle merit with silver in graded amounts.

s0418.literal: Horse prices were paid to Ajiji and others for auxiliary army horses.
s0418.idiomatic: Horse prices were paid to Ajiji and others for auxiliary army horses.

s0419.literal: Talaqai was granted fifty confiscated households.

s0420.literal: That year Qingyuan County of Baoding Route suffered flood, Songshan County of Pingyang Route drought, and Gaotang, Xiajin, Wucheng, and other counties locust damage to crops; this year's rent was remitted in all, totaling thirty-six thousand eight hundred forty shi.
s0420.idiomatic: That year Qingyuan County of Baoding Route flooded, Songshan County of Pingyang Route suffered drought, and locusts damaged crops in Gaotang, Xiajin, Wucheng, and other counties; this year's rent was remitted in all, totaling thirty-six thousand eight hundred forty shi.

s0421.literal: Twenty-two persons were sentenced to death.
s0421.idiomatic: Twenty-two persons were sentenced to death.
